name: Tags Input
summary: Labelled free-form multi-value field that composes Field Wrapper and canonical Tags, keeps draft text native, and delegates the controlled collection to the consuming target.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Field Wrapper composition root for the visible label, multi-value control, guidance, feedback, and status.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Canonical visible field label explicitly associated with the draft input.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.description: Input-like visual surface that arranges committed values and the native draft field without adding a widget role.

anatomy.name: values
anatomy.description: Native list of committed values in reading order; omitted or empty when the collection has no values.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: One list item containing a canonical Tag.

anatomy.name: tag
anatomy.description: Canonical Tag dependency representing one committed value and its optional named remove request.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.description: Native single-line text input that exclusively owns draft text editing and focus.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.description: Optional persistent Field Wrapper guidance associated with the draft input.

anatomy.name: feedback
anatomy.description: Optional current Error, Success, or Warning feedback associated with the draft input.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Pre-mounted visually hidden polite status region whose localized collection result text is target-owned.

variants.name: error
variants.description: Invalid collection with Error label, feedback, surface, hover, and focus treatment.

variants.name: success
variants.description: Validated collection with Success label, feedback, surface, hover, and focus treatment.

variants.name: warning
variants.description: Collection needing attention with Warning label, feedback, surface, hover, and focus treatment.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One responsive field density using canonical Tag sizing.

states.name: default
states.description: Editable field with its current controlled values and native draft.

states.name: empty
states.description: No committed values; the native draft field remains the only content inside the control.

states.name: hover
states.description: Fine-pointer hover on an editable control, preserving its active validation family.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Visible outer focus treatment while the native draft field has keyboard focus.

states.name: removeFocusVisible
states.description: Canonical Tag focus state on one named remove action without a second field ring.

states.name: readOnly
states.description: Focusable readable draft and committed values with no add or remove request.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Native disabled draft and disabled canonical Tag remove actions.

states.name: errorFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Error collection retaining its Error focus family.

states.name: successFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Success collection retaining its Success focus family.

states.name: warningFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Warning collection retaining its Warning focus family.

behavior.name: labelAssociation
behavior.description: The required visible label is the native draft field's accessible name and activates that field.

behavior.name: controlledCollection
behavior.description: Committed values are target-controlled records with stable identity. Neutral markup and shared CSS never create a second collection store.

behavior.name: nativeDraftOwnership
attributes: value IDL property represents the live draft
behavior.description: Static HTML may leave draft text natively uncontrolled; framework adapters may control the live value without changing committed collection ownership.

behavior.name: addRequest
behavior.description: Enter requests one trimmed non-empty draft value. The target accepts or rejects it, updates values, clears draft only on success, and returns focus to the field.

behavior.name: removeRequest
behavior.description: A canonical Tag requests removal of one identified value. The target reconciles the collection and returns focus to the draft field.

behavior.name: collectionValidation
behavior.description: The target validates committed values and domain policy. Required is collection-level and must not apply native required to an empty draft when committed values already satisfy the rule.

behavior.name: resultAnnouncement
behavior.description: The pre-mounted target-owned status receives concise localized results without announcing ordinary draft keystrokes or duplicating validation alerts.

behavior.name: freeTextBoundary
behavior.description: Without a separate accepted adapter policy, blur, punctuation, paste, Backspace, and Delete retain ordinary text-editing behavior and do not implicitly add or remove committed values.

behavior.name: noPopupSemantics
behavior.description: The free-form v1 field has no popup and therefore does not expose combobox, aria-autocomplete, aria-expanded, aria-controls, active-option, or listbox semantics.

behavior.name: formSerializationBoundary
behavior.description: The target adapter serializes controlled values through repeated native inputs, FormData, URL state, or its platform data API; the draft field must not masquerade as the committed collection.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible label explicitly associated with the native draft field.

properties.name: selectedValues
properties.description: Controlled committed-value collection rendered as native list items containing canonical Tags.

properties.name: inputValue
properties.description: Live draft text in the native entry field; it remains distinct from committed values.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Supplementary hint shown only while the draft is empty.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Persistent guidance associated with the native draft field.

properties.name: feedback
properties.description: Current validation or confirmation text; the selected variant determines its semantic presentation.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation for the complete field composition.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Marks the committed collection as required; the target synchronizes collection validity without applying native required to the draft.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables native draft editing and every rendered Tag removal action.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Keeps the draft and committed values focusable/readable while suppressing add requests and Tag removal actions.

properties.name: invalid
properties.description: Exposes target-known Error validity on the native draft field; Success and Warning leave it unset.

accessibility: Provide a visible label explicitly associated with the native draft field; placeholder text is supplementary only.
Render committed values in reading order as canonical Tags and give every available remove button a non-empty contextual accessible name.
Do not assign Combobox, Listbox, option, aria-autocomplete, aria-expanded, aria-controls, or active-option semantics when no conforming popup exists.
Keep Enter inert during IME composition and preserve ordinary native behavior for blur, punctuation, paste, Backspace, Delete, and text editing keys.

Use aria-invalid only for Error, associate persistent guidance and current feedback through aria-describedby, and communicate collection-level required state without misusing native required on the draft.
Pre-mount one empty polite atomic status and let the target announce concise localized add, remove, duplicate, capacity, and rejection results without echoing every keystroke.
After a successful add or remove reconciliation, return focus to the native draft field unless a documented target flow supplies a more logical surviving destination.
Preserve canonical Tag focus, disabled, forced-color, and 24 by 24 CSS-pixel removal-target behavior.
Read-only collections expose no removal actions; disabled collections disable the draft and every rendered removal action.
Keep long, localized, bidirectional, empty, and many-value content inside the available container without truncating accessible names.

web.notes: Canonical Field Wrapper, Tag, native input, list, feedback, and status markup use components/css/forms.css and primitives.css; the consumer owns values and request handling, with zero neutral collection runtime.

shopify.notes: Requires one concrete Shopify data owner and target-native serialization/update policy; canonical copied CSS and Tag composition are available.

react.notes: Expose distinct values/inputValue and add/remove callbacks; optional default values remain adapter-local without changing contract semantics.
